paragraphs: Stable Dynamic Motions and an immersive audio-visual experience, taking video generation to professional-grade production.

Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards—then refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production. Organize and manage your entire project like a director, all in one place.

Collaborate with your Agent to brainstorm ideas, analyze requirements, and generate scripts. Use dedicated Skills to create storyboards, posters, e-commerce assets, and more—all generated in parallel.
Freely arrange and edit nodes at any time, while preserving your creative flow and context throughout, so your ideas never lose momentum.
Let Your Agent Power Kling, Turn Ideas into Videos at Scale

An April Fools’ Day ad created by renowned director Sebastian Strasser and his studio Lipstick for luxury resale platform The RealReal, which won one Silver and one Bronze at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity.

An ad created by Argentine studio Purga Films to promote its AI advertising services. Made entirely with Kling AI, it won Bronze in the Classic Film category at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity.

An ad created by Kling AI and renowned studio Obsidian for Longchamp, marking the growing role of AI in luxury brand storytelling and demonstrating Kling AI’s capabilities in high-end commercial production.

A heartwarming AI short film that went viral during the 2026 Qingming Festival, created entirely with Kling AI. It generated over 100 million views across platforms and was praised as “the most human AI film ever made.”
The first Hollywood production to publicly disclose the use of AI video generation in a large-scale production, reaching over 44 million views worldwide and topping the Amazon Prime series chart.
A feature film co-produced by leading AI studio Fountain 0 and Kling AI, directed by Ash Koosha.All 135 minutes of the film’s visuals were generated entirely with Kling AI.

Kling AI, Chaocreate Wu Zhiqi, and Warner Music China collaborated to create the virtual idol Wu Aihua and her debut MV, with all visuals generated by Kling AI. The MV has garnered over 11.2 million views worldwide.
Kling AI created the felt-animation MV "I Like U Like" for rising idol group TNT, garnering 1.32 billion likes and sparking both fan engagement and widespread entertainment buzz.

Xania Monet’s “How Was I Supposed to Know” became the first AI song to reach the Billboard Top 30.The creator brings the virtual artist to life beyond music through social clips and music videos made with Kling AI.
For e-commerce fashion, generate on-model showcases, styling content, and engaging product videos from product images, model images, or brand assets to streamline content production.
For beverage and FMCG advertising, create brand films, scenario-based ads, and social media content centered around packaging, product benefits, and consumption occasions.
For consumer electronics and 3C advertising, generate product breakdowns, feature demos, tech-forward films, and e-commerce marketing videos from product images and key selling points.
For smart cockpit applications, generate high-quality videos and dynamic content for center consoles, HUDs, and rear-seat entertainment screens, enhancing the in-car experience.
For mobile devices such as phones and tablets, enable efficient video generation for photo, editing, wallpaper, and social creation apps, expanding creative possibilities on mobile.

For TVs, computers, and other large-screen devices, enable video generation for home entertainment, desktop creative tools, content platforms, and brand showcases, enhancing interactive and creative experiences.
For smartwatches and other wearables, generate lightweight visual content such as dynamic watch faces, wellness motivation, and workout companions to enhance personalization and engagement.
Kling AI walks alongside creators. We always believe in the power of creativity, and firmly believe that Kling AI can provide creators with more new possibilities.

Kling has opened more doors than I ever imagined. Its prompt adherence and crystal-clear 4K output are unmatched, bringing my vision to life with remarkable accuracy. It was the primary tool across both Echo Hunter films, key to their cinematic quality. I can't wait to see how it evolves.
